profile_text.body:
Perplexity is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question.

The company's tracked products include Perplexity AI, a search-augmented large language model accessible via its main website, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, an enterprise-oriented offering that incorporates internal knowledge search, data indexing, single sign-on, and audit logs. Perplexity also maintains an MCP server, listed as ai.perplexity/mcp-server, which exposes real-time web search, reasoning, and research capabilities through its API.

Perplexity is involved in substantial litigation. Cases have been filed against it by Cable News Network Inc., The New York Times Company, Chicago Tribune Company LLC, and Encyclopaedia Britannica Inc., all in the Southern District of New York, as well as by Amazon.com Services LLC in the Northern District of California and before the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Additional suits from parties identified as Gagleard have been filed in both the Eastern and Northern Districts of California, and a case brought by Noel is pending in the Northern District of California.
